sloka: एष पुष्पवहो वायुः सुख स्पर्शो हिमावहः ।ताम् विचिन्तयतः कान्ताम् पावक प्रतिमो मम ॥४-१-५३॥
transliteration: eṣa puṣpavaho vāyuḥ sukha sparśo himāvahaḥ ।tām vicintayataḥ kāntām pāvaka pratimo mama ॥4-1-53॥

translations.english: 'The pleasant touch of the wind, which made me happy in the company of Sita intensifies my grief now in her absence.
